programme.desc: Tha an t-acras uabhasach air Baba 's tha bhrù aige rùchdail! Ge-tà, chan eil sgeul air Oona son a thoirt dhachaigh gu bhiadh... an tig aig a bhuthaid bheag dàna a shlighe fhèin a dhèanamh air ais chun an fhaiche? Baba is a hungry puffling and his tummy is very rumbly! However, Oona has gone out to play and isn't around to take him home for dinner. Will the adventurous Baba be able to make his own way back to the puffin burrow?

programme.title: ’S E Iasg a Th’Annam (I’m a Fish)
programme.desc: Tha an Cairbean-siùil a' mìneachadh mar ‘s iad na h-èisg as luaithe san fhairge agus mar ‘s ainneamh a thèid an glacadh. The Sailfish explains that they are the fastest fish in the ocean, and how they very seldom get caught by predators.

programme.title: Peataichean/Pets
programme.desc: Sreath ùr anns a bheil Eilidh NicCarmaig a’ coinneachadh ri clann òga agus a’ faighinn a-mach ciamar a tha iad a’ coimhead às dèidh agus a’ cluich cuide rim peataichean aig an taigh. Anns a’ phrògram seo, tha Eilidh a’ cèilidh air Alec agus Doris, an cat ‘Burmese’ aige. Tha Doris 8 bliadhna dh’aois agus ‘s e cat àlainn da-rìreabh a th’ innte. Gheibh sinn a-mach barrachd mu bhith a’ coimhead às dèidh cait agus mu na rudan snog is spòrsail a bhios Alec agus Doris a’ dèanamh còmhla. Gheibh sinn cuideachd comhairle agus fiosrachadh bho Eilidh fhèin mu bhith a’ làimhseachadh, ag oideachadh agus a’ coimhead às dèidh peataichean. Eilidh Cormack meets young children who are pet owners. Together, they show, tell and share how they care for, play and interact with their pets at home. In this episode, Eilidh visits Alec and his beautiful Burmese cat Doris, who is eight years old. We find out about how to look after cats and all the lovely stuff Alec and Doris get up to together. Eilidh also shares fun and interesting facts along with advice on looking after pets at home, including how best to handle, train and feed them.

programme.title: Abadas
programme.desc: Tha na h-Abadas air a bhith trang a' togail caisteal-sneachd 's iad a-nis a' coimhead air n-adhart ri geama a chluich. 'S e Hari a tha a' lorg am facal an-diugh 's e am broinn an taighe. After building a snow castle in the mountains, the Abadas settle down with Ben for the word game. Soon, Hari is sent to look for a stool inside the house.

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Sgeulachdan do chlann òga. Tha Niall Iain Dòmhnallach a’ leughadh An Sionnach agus an Rionnag. Chaidh an leabhar a sgrìobhadh agus a dhealbhachadh le Coralie Bickford-Smith agus chaidh eadar-theangachadh dhan Ghàidhlig le Morag Stiùbhart. A bedtime story for young children. Niall Iain Macdonald reads An Sionnach agus an Rionnag, written and illustrated by Coralie Bickford-Smith and translated into Gaelic by Morag Stewart.

programme.title: An Teaghlach Rìoghail an Ath-dhoras/The Royals Next Door
programme.desc: Nuair a tha Stella a’ cur speuchlairean oirre 'son coimhead nas glice – mar Mia agus Stella, chan eil rudan ag obrachadh a-mach mar a tha i a' lùiginn! When Stella puts glasses on to appear more intelligent, like Mia, things don’t work out as she had hoped!

programme.title: An Teaghlach Rìoghail an Ath-dhoras/The Royals Next Door
programme.desc: Tha Molaidh na boil’ nuair a tha i fhèin is Stella a' dol a-mach air Oidhche Shamhna. Tha Stella a’ dèanamh a-mach gu bheil i ro shean air a shon - ach an dùil a’ bheil sin fìor? Molaidh is really excited when she and Stella go out trick or treating. Stella makes out she is too old for Halloween, but is this really true?

programme.title: Clann Na Cruinne
programme.desc: Rugadh Hend ann an Ieman ach dh’fhàg i fhèin, a màthair, a piuthar ‘s a bràthair nuair bha i còig, air sgàth a’ chogaidh. Tha i an dòchas bàrdachd a sgrìobhadh gus an ionnsaich an clas mu beatha – ‘s dòcha gun ionnsaich i fhèin rud cuideachd. Hend was born in Yemen but she left with her mother, sister and brother, as a result of the war. She hopes to write poetry so the class will learn about her life - perhaps she will learn something, too.

programme.title: Belle and Sebastian
programme.desc: Tha trioblaid aig Angelina oir tha cion luchd-turais a' ciallachadh nach eil mòran a’ ceannach an càis aice. Tha i feumach air cuideachadh. ’S math g’ eil Belle is Sebastian deiseil is deònach. Angelina has a problem as a lack of tourists mean that there aren't many people buying her cheese. She needs help. It’s a good thing that Belle and Sebastian are ready and willing.

programme.title: Seonaidh | Shaun the Sheep
programme.desc: Tha a h-uile duine a' coimhead air adhart ri oidhche shàmhach air an tuathanas nuair a tha Bitzer a' fàs an-fhoiseil - chan urrainn dha suidhe aig fois. Nuair a thòisicheas a h-uile duine eile leis an aon ghearan feumaidh Seonaidh faighinn a-mach dè tha ceàrr. Everyone is settling down for a relaxed night on the farm when Bitzer begins to act very strangely - he just can't sit still. When his peculiar behaviour starts spreading around the flock, Shaun decides he must find out what's causing it.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Abigail
programme.desc: Tha an Dutch Baby annasach ach anabarrach blasta. Brunch sònraichte air nach dìochuimhnich thu a’ chiad ghreis. The unusual but extremely delicious Dutch baby is a special brunch that you won't forget in a hurry. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Machair
programme.desc: Drama Gàidhlig stèidhichte ann an Leòdhas. Gaelic soap set on the Isle of Lewis.

programme.title: Slighe Naoimh Cuithbeirt/St Cuthbert's Way
programme.desc: Iagan MacNèill a’leantail Slighe Naoimh Chuithbeirt a Monadh Weetwood gu Lindisfarne. Iagan MacNeil explores the St Cuthbert’s Way, from Weetwood Moor to Lindisfarne.

programme.title: Mas Fhior
programme.desc: Niall Iain Macdonald hosts a quiz show where more than general knowledge is required to win. Standing in the way of our two teams from winning are the Pretenders, who, from the comfort of their own homes, are on a mission to fox our contestants. Which of this week’s teams, Samual and Aidan or Floraidh and Ruairidh, will get the upper hand and have a chance to take home the grand prize? Niall Iain Dòmhnallach le farpais cheist ùr far a bheil barrachd air eòlas coitcheann a dhìth gus buannachadh. Tha na Mas Fhìoraich a’ gabhail pàirt bhon dachaighean ’s ag amas air a’ chùis a dhèanamh air an dà sgioba. Cò aca bho sgiobaidhean na seachdain-sa, Samual & Aidan no Floraidh & Ruairidh, a gheibh làmh an uachdar agus cothrom fhaighinn air an duais mhòr? In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Valtos | Aig a’ Mhullach
programme.desc: Na DJs Gàidhealach, Valtos, le cuirm sgoinneil aig mullach a’ Chàirn Ghuirm. Seallaidhean àlainn is ceòl air leth. Thig cuide ri Martyn is Dan is iad a’ dèanamh ùrlar-dannsaidh à Stèisean Tàrmagain – am fear as àirde ann an Alba. Le taic bho Eilidh NicCarmaig, Lana Pheutan is Ruairidh Gray, agus criomagan bhon chuirm aca sna Barrowlands ann an Glaschu. Highland DJs Valtos stage a unique event at the top of Cairngorm Mountain, featuring beautiful scenery and incredible music. Join Martyn and Dan as they transform the iconic Ptarmigan Station into the highest dance floor in Scotland. Featuring contributions from musical collaborators Eilidh Cormack, Lana Pheutan and Ruairidh Gray, with highlights from their sell-out show at the Glasgow Barrowlands.

programme.title: Coin Trusaidh/Muster Dogs
programme.desc: Air an t-slighe bheòthail seo, tha sinn a’ faighinn sealladh nas dlùithe air beatha còig luchd-trèanaidh bho air feadh Astràilia agus iad uile a’ gabhail pàirt san deuchainn againn: cuilean Kelpie a thoirt gu ìre – airson a bhith mar phàirt de sgioba nan con trusaidh. Chan eil e a’ toirt fad sam bith dhan na cuileanan àlainn seo iad fhèin a bhlàthachadh ris an luchd-seilbh ùra aca agus tha an trèanadh aca a’ tòiseachadh gu luath. Tha ainmean air a thoirt dhaibh; le Annie, Gossip, Lucifer, Spice agus Chet a’ faighinn trèanadh air thoiseach air a’ chiad dùbhlan aca, a’ meas na sgilean aca aig aois ceithir mìosan. An action-packed yet intimate character journey about the lives of five very different Australian dog trainers as they participate in our experiment: to take a new Kelpie pup and transform it from a greenhorn to an efficient working member of the mustering pack. These cute new puppies instantly wriggle their way into the hearts of our new owners and training begins quickly. Names are given and Annie, Gossip, Lucifer, Spice and Chet embark on the challenge of training for the first assessment of their skills at four months. Dubbed in Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Srùb: Scotland on Coffee
programme.desc: Thig air turas sònraichte cuide ri Ellen NicDhòmhnaill ’s i ag ionnsachadh a h-uile sìon mu chofaidh. Join Ellen MacDonald on a journey to discover all there is to know about coffee.

programme.title: Seo BBC ALBA. This is BBC ALBA
programme.desc: Sealladh ùr bho Alba. A new view from Scotland.

programme.title: Pubs, Ponds and Power: The Story of the Village
programme.desc: The story of Cromford. A picturesque Derbyshire village at the heart of famous industrialist Sir Richard Arkwright's mechanised cotton mills and a textile revolution. Presenter and archaeologist Ben Robinson discovers it wasn't just an industrial revolution. Cromford became a new kind of village, built to service the enterprise of this powerful man.

programme.title: Ian Rankin's Hidden Edinburgh
programme.desc: Edinburgh is often described as the 'Athens of the North' but its most famous detective Inspector Rebus views Scotland's capital in quite a different light - it is a crime scene waiting to happen. As his creator Ian Rankin prepares to write the last ever Rebus case, the award-winning author re-visits the key locations from the books. From the city's 'pubic triangle' and the home of Scotland's most infamous madam to a police station where he was interviewed about a real murder, Rankin explores the hidden Edinburgh into which tourists never venture.

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo confronts a detachment of Gurkhas, produces a fine heritage cheese and discovers a monster cracker that is key to making plastic, before ending his postwar journey from Merseyside to Teesside in a recreated 1950s street, where childhood memories are rekindled in the Beamish Museum hairdresser.

programme.desc: Programmes start at 7.00pm.

programme.desc: Daily from 7.00pm.

programme.title: This is BBC Four
programme.desc: Programmes start at 7.00pm.

programme.title: BBC Proms
programme.desc: This specially curated programme features a trio of pieces, all inspired by the wonders of the sky. To open, Richard Strauss’s powerhouse symphonic poem, made famous by Stanley Kubrick’s 2001: A Space Odyssey. This masterpiece of orchestral splendour envelops the Royal Albert Hall, performed by the BBC Philharmonic under the baton of John Storgårds. Judith Weir’s ethereal Moon and Star follows swiftly, a stunning musical interpretation of Emily Dickinson’s poem of the same name, performed by the BBC Symphony Orchestra, the BBC Singers and Ryan Wigglesworth. The hall lights up in a choral cloud, evoking the night sky. Finishing with a debut performance by the Spanish National Orchestra, Ravel’s Alborada del gracioso is brought to the Royal Albert Hall under the watchful eye of conductor David Afkham, bringing Spanish flare to round off this programme. Presented by Katie Derham

programme.title: BBC Proms
programme.desc: The unmistakable, hypnotic masterpiece from the Spanish National Orchestra's Proms debut.

programme.desc: Richard Skinner and John Peel present the pop chart programme, first broadcast on 9 August 1984. Featuring Tracey Ullman, Windjammer, Jeffrey Osborne, Blancmange, Laura Branigan and Frankie Goes to Hollywood.

programme.title: Top of the Pops
programme.desc: Janice Long and Mark Goodier present the pop chart programme, first broadcast on 4 August 1988. Featuring Kim Wilde, The Funky Worm and Fairground Attraction.

programme.title: Tony Bennett at the London Palladium: BBC Sessions
programme.desc: The truly legendary American singer celebrates his 85th birthday in fine style, with a special concert at the historic London Palladium. Accompanied by his quartet, Tony Bennett moves effortlessly through a repertoire spanning 60 years, with songs such as Steppin' Out with My Baby, The Good Life, Smile and his favourite, I Left My Heart in San Francisco. He is joined for two unique duets by stellar British singers Cleo Laine and Leona Lewis.

programme.title: The Media Show
programme.desc: The Economist's interview with Elon Musk attracted global attention before Musk then described interviewer Zanny Minton Beddoes as a 'traitor to the West'. The interview followed 90 minutes of conversation for The Insider, The Economist's video series. Zanny Minton Beddoes, Editor-in-Chief of The Economist, explains how the interview came about and the reaction after it was published. Huge wildfires in France and Spain have dominated news coverage across Europe, creating difficult and sometimes dangerous conditions for journalists reporting from the scene. Sadiya Chowdhury, correspondent at Sky News, explains her approach, and Mehdi Lebouachera, global director at AFP, gives the backstory to a photograph that appeared on front pages around the world.

programme.title: Animal Park
programme.desc: There’s excitement and tension in the emu paddock because for the first time in years, chicks could be on the way. But the eggs will only be viable if dad Biscuit stays sitting on the nest. In this species, the male takes full responsibility for incubating and raising the young, but Biscuit hasn’t always been the most reliable father. If he abandons the nest and eggs too soon, the chicks won’t survive. Meanwhile, Hamza is on a photographic mission. Armed with his long lens and the expert eye of park veteran keeper Ian, he’s challenged to capture two majestic species in a single shot, the native red kite and the African lion, but it’s easier said than done. Over in Animal Adventure, Pesto the porcupette is learning to eat his greens, and the keepers are hoping he’ll put on enough weight to meet his next developmental milestone.

programme.title: Trace, Track, Get My Car Back
programme.desc: Vehicle recovery specialist Richard is tracking expensive farm vehicles stolen in broad daylight. He traces them to a scrapyard, but as he arrives, they’re on the move again.

programme.title: Expert Witness
programme.desc: A fibre specialist from the UK brings closure to Australia’s longest-running murder investigation. And a forensic pharmacologist uses her expertise to ensure a murder charge after two brutal killings.

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Danny visits The One Show studio, where Alex Jones and Roman Kemp reveal their love of antiques and collectibles. In Builth Wells, two teams of well-known faces search for bargains.

programme.title: The Hairdresser Mysteries

programme.title: Animal Park
programme.desc: There’s excitement and tension in the emu paddock because for the first time in years, chicks could be on the way. But the eggs will only be viable if dad Biscuit stays sitting on the nest. In this species, the male takes full responsibility for incubating and raising the young, but Biscuit hasn’t always been the most reliable father. If he abandons the nest and eggs too soon, the chicks won’t survive. Meanwhile, Hamza is on a photographic mission. Armed with his long lens and the expert eye of park veteran keeper Ian, he’s challenged to capture two majestic species in a single shot, the native red kite and the African lion, but it’s easier said than done. Over in Animal Adventure, Pesto the porcupette is learning to eat his greens, and the keepers are hoping he’ll put on enough weight to meet his next developmental milestone.

programme.title: Trace, Track, Get My Car Back
programme.desc: Vehicle recovery specialist Richard is tracking expensive farm vehicles stolen in broad daylight. He traces them to a scrapyard, but as he arrives, they’re on the move again.

programme.desc: A fibre specialist from the UK brings closure to Australia’s longest-running murder investigation. And a forensic pharmacologist uses her expertise to ensure a murder charge after two brutal killings.

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Jules Hudson gets to show off a gloriously sunny Cornwall to an entrepreneurial couple who are on the lookout for a property with potential for a holiday let business as well as a home. Jules also tours a disused china clay quarry, where work has begun to create a sustainable and inclusive garden village by building more than 1,000 energy-efficient homes.

programme.title: The Bidding Room
programme.desc: Nigel Havers presides as members of the public with interesting items to sell come face to face with five dealers who bid against each other to try to bag themselves a bargain. Before facing the dealers, each seller has their item valued by auctioneer Simon Bower. Simon also gives them top tips on the history and key characteristics of their piece, so that when they enter the bidding room, they have all the information they need to try to haggle the best possible price from the dealers. All the dealers are spending their own money but have no idea what the sellers have brought in.

programme.title: The Bidding Room
programme.desc: Nigel Havers presides as members of the public with interesting items to sell come face to face with five dealers who bid against each other to try to bag themselves a bargain. Simon also gives them top tips on the history and key characteristics of their piece, so that when they enter the bidding room, they have all the information they need to try to haggle the best possible price from the dealers. All the dealers are spending their own money but have no idea what the sellers have brought in.

programme.title: BBC Comedy Short Films
programme.desc: Jobless is a sitcom all about the Adenugas, a middle-class British Nigerian family in Milton Keynes, in particular 16-year-old twin brother and sister Kehinde and Taiwo. Kenny is the family joker, who dreams of fame and fortune; sister Tai is, by contrast, sarcastic, super-smart and anxious to prove it. The twins live at home with their parents. Their mum, Bunmi, (chatty, energetic, control-freak tendencies, has a very stern side) runs Bunmi’s Beauty Salon, and despairs at her hapless offspring and their schemes to hit the big time. Tai and Kenny are desperate to make money by any means necessary – not only is financial independence very alluring, but the pressure they face from Bunmi doesn’t help. The twins’ different personalities inform their different approaches, however it seems neither of those personalities are quite compatible with the world of work.

programme.title: BBC Comedy Short Films
programme.desc: Sports mockumentary about GB Paralympian Darren Silverstone, who stole the hearts of a nation before his infamous chokey-o in Tokyo. For the first time, he tells his story - and starts his glorious comeback. In Tokyo 2020, Darren Silverstone was the Paras GB poster boy. (He was on yoghurts, too.) He cruised to the final and charmed the nation along the way with his signature dance move, the dazzle. But as he took that final bend ready to take gold, Silverstone lost his head and celebrated too soon - and in the process, became a national figure of fun. His subsequent journey in the public eye brought approval and consternation in equal measure: from those unforgettably self-deprecating betting adverts to his turn on The Masked Singer as Breadbin. Darren’s best friend and pilot rider in Tokyo, little Paul Potter, was never seen again in the public eye. The two haven’t spoken since. And now, Silverstone’s back. Ready to take to the tandem at Paris 2024. But is he ready? Who will he be riding with? This is I Am Darren.

programme.title: Death in Paradise
programme.desc: A distillery owner is poisoned during a group tasting of his premium rum. But the case is shrouded in mystery when it is revealed that all the guests drank from the same bottle. The team must dig deep into the past, uncovering secrets that our suspects have gone to great lengths to bury, in order to get to the bottom of this case.

programme.desc: Join RuPaul's Drag Race UK Season 2 winner Lawrence Chaney on their adventure to California, where they travel all around Tinseltown. Lawrence and their crew of celebrity friends, drag queens, and other Angelenos take a deep dive, asking the question, 'What makes Los Angeles so special?' In this episode, Lawrence and Rock M Sakura get in touch with their spiritual sides at a Los Angeles metaphysical supply store.

programme.title: BBC Comedy Short Films
programme.desc: Jobless is a sitcom all about the Adenugas, a middle-class British Nigerian family in Milton Keynes, in particular 16-year-old twin brother and sister Kehinde and Taiwo. Kenny is the family joker, who dreams of fame and fortune; sister Tai is, by contrast, sarcastic, super-smart and anxious to prove it. The twins live at home with their parents. Their mum, Bunmi, (chatty, energetic, control-freak tendencies, has a very stern side) runs Bunmi’s Beauty Salon, and despairs at her hapless offspring and their schemes to hit the big time. Tai and Kenny are desperate to make money by any means necessary – not only is financial independence very alluring, but the pressure they face from Bunmi doesn’t help. The twins’ different personalities inform their different approaches, however it seems neither of those personalities are quite compatible with the world of work.

programme.title: The Catch Up

programme.title: BBC Comedy Short Films
programme.desc: Sports mockumentary about GB Paralympian Darren Silverstone, who stole the hearts of a nation before his infamous chokey-o in Tokyo. For the first time, he tells his story - and starts his glorious comeback. In Tokyo 2020, Darren Silverstone was the Paras GB poster boy. (He was on yoghurts, too.) He cruised to the final and charmed the nation along the way with his signature dance move, the dazzle. But as he took that final bend ready to take gold, Silverstone lost his head and celebrated too soon - and in the process, became a national figure of fun. His subsequent journey in the public eye brought approval and consternation in equal measure: from those unforgettably self-deprecating betting adverts to his turn on The Masked Singer as Breadbin. Darren’s best friend and pilot rider in Tokyo, little Paul Potter, was never seen again in the public eye. The two haven’t spoken since. And now, Silverstone’s back. Ready to take to the tandem at Paris 2024. But is he ready? Who will he be riding with? This is I Am Darren.

programme.title: Night at the Museum: Battle of the Smithsonian
programme.desc: Action comedy sequel. The New York exhibits, sent to storage in Washington DC, call Larry – now in business – for help fighting a supernatural threat. Beneath the assorted Smithsonian institutions lurk new enemies... and unexpected allies.

programme.title: Death in Paradise
programme.desc: A distillery owner is poisoned during a group tasting of his premium rum. But the case is shrouded in mystery when it is revealed that all the guests drank from the same bottle. So, how could the killer ensure only the victim would wind up dead? With Seb’s unorthodox methods proving useful to the investigation, Mervin learns an important lesson in slowing down. The team must dig deep into the past, uncovering secrets that our suspects have gone to great lengths to bury, in order to get to the bottom of this case.

programme.title: Ghosts Australia
programme.desc: The Australian version of the hit UK series. When city couple Kate and Sean inherit Ramshead Manor, a run-down country estate, they see it as a sign for a fresh new start. But after Kate has a near-death experience, she gains the ability to see and hear ghosts – and discovers there are several living in the mansion. Kate must navigate the ghosts' issues while trying to start a hotel business with Sean, who remains unable to see them.

programme.title: The Golden Cobra

programme.title: The Golden Cobra
programme.desc: Rhys has a falling-out with Connor, the hardest boy in school. Basil, Nick and Jub brainstorm ideas to drum up business for the Golden Cobra and compete with their rival Ernish.

programme.title: The Golden Cobra
programme.desc: Strapped for cash, Nick and Jub agree to deliver a package of unknown goods for shady business owner Martin Bastard, sending them on a spooky trip to Aberdare.

programme.title: The Golden Cobra
programme.desc: Mona and her friends join the school tough nuts Connor and Bighead for a game of truth or dare. Samita worries Mona is in over her head and getting involved with the wrong crowd.

programme.title: The Golden Cobra
programme.desc: Basil and Jub decide it's finally time to make a TV advert for the Golden Cobra. Samita worries about her daughter's new relationship with infamous school bully Connor.

programme.title: The Golden Cobra
programme.desc: Down in the dumps and riddled with guilt, a broken Nick reflects on his past and the devastating, life-changing decision that led him to where he is now.

programme.title: The Golden Cobra
programme.desc: On a beautiful summer's day in Ebbw Vale, Nick finally steps up to the plate as his son Rhys suffers an injury too harrowing for this blurb.

programme.title: The Golden Cobra
programme.desc: Messiah of rugby Scott Quinnell blesses Ebbw Vale with his divine presence, bringing a heavenly warmth to the town. Basil sees his perfect opportunity for revenge.

programme.title: Ideal
programme.desc: Sitcom about a small-time dope dealer and his strange collection of acquaintances. Moz tries to hide his dope dealing from the born again Christian builders working in his flat. Is lack of sleep making Nicki hallucinate, and what's in the big sack Judith is dragging into her flat?

programme.title: Evolution
programme.desc: How did the bat get so hungry? Chris Packham sets out to answer a deceptively simple question: how the drive to find food shaped life on earth and gave rise to one of nature’s most insatiable feeders. This is the story of the origin of bums, guts, jaws and super hearing, and a 500-million-year chain of innovation, survival and hunger.

programme.title: This is BBC Two
programme.desc: Highlights of programmes on BBC Two.

programme.title: Money for Nothing
programme.desc: Are creative curves good for us? Katie and Sophie attempt a wavy redesign that leaves them feeling seasick, and woodworker Bruce is pushed to his limits trying to rejuvenate a pair of old, dated desk ends. Meanwhile, Sarah Moore attempts to trick the eye by updating a display cabinet – but will all three revamps produce profits?

programme.title: The Bidding Room
programme.desc: Nigel Havers presides as members of the public with interesting items to sell come face to face with five dealers who bid against each other to try to bag themselves a bargain. Before facing the dealers, each seller has their item valued by auctioneer Simon Bower. Simon also gives them top tips on the history and key characteristics of their piece, so that when they enter the bidding room, they have all the information they need to try to haggle the best possible price from the dealers. All the dealers are spending their own money but have no idea what the sellers have brought in.

programme.title: Marcus Wareing Simply Provence
programme.desc: Inspired by herbes de Provence, Marcus wants to create his own dried mix. Also, he boldly challenges a French chocolatier to flavour his wares with English breakfast tea.

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: Twenty-four hours a day, the latest national and international stories as they break.

programme.title: Richard Osman's House of Games
programme.desc: Every day this week, celebrity contestants Sean Fletcher, Louise Minchin, Chris Washington and Kimberly Wyatt take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, quiz legend Richard Osman. A daily winner is declared following a quickfire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. Will the winning stars opt for the much-coveted House of Games wheelie luggage, or will they be tempted by the House of Games reusable coffee mug, which is brand new for this series?

programme.title: The Finish Line
programme.desc: Roman Kemp and his sidekick Sarah Greene host this quiz show, where the contestants race on moving podiums across the studio floor. Correct answers get the players moving, while wrong answers stop them in their tracks. Five contestants battle across a series of fast-paced qualifiers and head-to-head races, where the aim of the game is simple – make it to the finish line before your rivals. The winner then races against the track itself in an attempt to win the £5,000 cash prize.

programme.title: Do You Know Your Place?
programme.desc: The week reaches its finale as Vernon Kay hosts the last stop on this week’s UK-wide adventure. TV icon Anneka Rice, comedian Shane Todd and Radio 1Xtra DJ Remi Burgz have one final shot at glory, with Paul Gorton leading an unreliable tour of Coleraine.

programme.title: Hairy Bikers' Bakeation
programme.desc: After nearly 5,000 miles, the Hairy Bikers reach the last leg of their journey, which takes them through northern Spain. Their journey starts in San Sebastian, where they get stuck in to the local cuisine with pinchos (tapas gone large!), a traditional Basque dining club and goose barnacles, a challenging local delicacy. They bake up a storm too, in the form of a pan rustico (traditional bread), a fabulous Basque chicken pie and a seafood empanada, packed with locally caught fish. But that's not all. They also learn the secret properties of spelt, Europe's forgotten grain, and use it to bake, not only bread, but a giant spelt sausage roll packed with chorizo. In Galicia, they join in local celebrations - a quiemada - which involve flaming liquour and an ancient pagan ceremony. Their 5,000-mile adventure ends in Santiago de Compostela with a spectacular firework display to celebrate the 800th anniversary of St James. Great food and great company, the Spanish leg is a fitting end to the Hairy Bikers' brilliant Bake-ation.

programme.title: The Farmers' Country Showdown
programme.desc: Rodney and Annabell’s Cumbrian farm has been in the family for 80 years, and since the beginning has always reared Ayrshire cattle. With their finest cows in tow, they return to the competition ring at the Westmorland County Show to try to win one of the top prizes. Meanwhile, Cheshire farmer Helen is getting her pedigree Red Poll cattle in top condition with welcome help from friend Thomas. She has set her sights on a champion win, but as both pairs are taking their own favourites into the show ring and will be in direct competition with one another, anything could happen.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: From Clitheroe in Lancashire, Michael Aspel and the experts unearth an unlikely mix of treasures including a Victorian multi-purpose pen knife which pre-dates the modern Swiss army variety, a miniature theatre built by a stage manager with Sir Frank Benson's touring Shakespearian Company and a Japanese lacquered chest of astonishing rarity and value.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Flog It! comes from historic Haddon Hall in Derbyshire. Paul Martin is joined by experts Michael Baggott and Caroline Hawley. Together, they pick out a selection of interesting antiques and collectables to be sold at the local auction house. Michael finds an oriental carving which he thinks is a cut above, and Caroline is drawn to a model of a Second World War V1 bomb which reveals some fascinating history. Paul gets out and about on a quest to find out the extraordinary story of the Peak District National Park.

programme.title: Richard Osman's House of Games
programme.desc: Every day this week, four previous players who came close to winning but never quite made it - Gethin Jones, Tiff Stevenson, Kate Thornton and Gary Wilmot - take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, quiz legend Richard Osman. A daily winner is declared following a quickfire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. With their second chance at winning a prize, will they opt for the House of Games wheelie luggage, or will they be tempted by the very popular bee hotel?

programme.title: Just One Thing
programme.desc: In Rotherham, 25-year-old sports fanatic Kerry dreams of becoming a Paralympian after a skiing accident changed her life. Roman Kemp wants to introduce her to an unlikely ally: the humble beetroot. Studies show that beetroot can boost fitness performance and enhance brain power. It is a vibrant vegetable with serious athletic potential.

programme.title: Iolo's Anglesey
programme.desc: Iolo goes by boat to Ynys Badrig, an offshore island which is the northernmost point of Anglesey and Wales, and the potential site of a new gannet colony. He explores a stunning wood at the centre of Anglesey, with carpets of spring flowers and native red squirrels. He watches peregrines on the Menai Strait, and on wetlands near RAF Valley, he finds nesting sand martins, spots otters and has a rare sighting of a bittern.

programme.title: Beechgrove Garden
programme.desc: Brian Cunningham’s beginner’s guide to vegetable growing started in April, and now it’s time to reap the rewards as he starts to harvest from the veg plot at Beechgrove Garden. Calum Clunie sows for winter crops as he starts the sowing cycle again on his family-sized plo. He also refreshes the containers he started in April as a demonstration of just what you can do if space is limited and you only room for some pots. Brian and Calum tackle Beechgrove’s hedges after checking carefully for bird nest activity, and Brian advises on caring for common houseplants. There is a visit to St Andrews Botanic Garden, along with the week’s handy hints.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Frances Tophill returns to Damson Farm in Bath and spends the day with owner Alison and a very special guest – Dame Mary Berry. Returning to the city where she grew up and went to school, Mary shares how the landscapes and countryside around Bath nurtured a lifelong love of gardening and the great outdoors. Together, they share practical gardening advice and celebrate the very best of summer, harvesting homegrown fruit, vegetables and flowers at their seasonal peak. Frances has advice on how to create a wild corner that's both beautiful and beneficial for wildlife while collecting seeds for future displays. Arit Anderson visits an inspiring urban edible garden in London, and there's a city gardener transforming a compact space into a thriving haven for wildlife. Toby Buckland shares clever ways to extend the growing season and make the most of summer harvests, and in Birmingham, there's a visit to a predominantly Punjabi allotment community where growing exceptional produce is intertwined with family, culture and tradition, creating plots that are as productive as they are beautiful.

programme.title: Bergerac
programme.desc: The battle between Bergerac and Arthur Wakefield intensifies as his enemies gain ground. Since discovering that Cate may have betrayed Arthur, Bergerac feels he is closing in on his chief suspect. But a storm is gathering, with Chloe’s expose gaining momentum when she finds new evidence against him that indicates there may be some truth in John Blakely’s accusations after all. Meanwhile, there’s a huge surprise in store when the missing money from the ransom appears.

programme.title: QI XL
programme.desc: Sandi goes tricking and treating with Ria Lina, Eshaan Akbar, Jimmy Carr and Alan Davies.

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: Insights and global interviews on the news stories of the day. With Paddy O'Connell.

programme.title: Hoard
programme.desc: Ten-year-old Maria lives with her deeply troubled single mother, Cynthia, who is utterly devoted to her daughter but in the grip of a hoarding obsession, fanatically scavenging discarded and random objects, and living in squalor. When an accident leads to Maria being taken in by Michelle, a foster mother, her life appears to be on an upward trajectory - until Michael, one of Michelle's former charges, returns to stay at his old foster home. A strange and obsessive relationship develops between them.

programme.title: The Finish Line

Correct answers get the players moving, while wrong answers stop them in their tracks. programme.title: Do You Know Your Place?
programme.desc: The week reaches its finale as Vernon Kay hosts the last stop on this week’s UK-wide adventure. TV icon Anneka Rice, comedian Shane Todd and Radio 1Xtra DJ Remi Burgz have one final shot at glory, with Paul Gorton leading an unreliable tour of Coleraine.

programme.title: Hairy Bikers' Bakeation
programme.desc: After nearly 5,000 miles, the Hairy Bikers reach the last leg of their journey, which takes them through northern Spain. Their journey starts in San Sebastian, where they get stuck in to the local cuisine with pinchos (tapas gone large!), a traditional Basque dining club and goose barnacles, a challenging local delicacy. They bake up a storm too, in the form of a pan rustico (traditional bread), a fabulous Basque chicken pie and a seafood empanada, packed with locally caught fish. But that's not all. They also learn the secret properties of spelt, Europe's forgotten grain, and use it to bake, not only bread, but a giant spelt sausage roll packed with chorizo. In Galicia, they join in local celebrations - a quiemada - which involve flaming liquour and an ancient pagan ceremony. Their 5,000-mile adventure ends in Santiago de Compostela with a spectacular firework display to celebrate the 800th anniversary of St James. Great food and great company, the Spanish leg is a fitting end to the Hairy Bikers' brilliant Bake-ation.

programme.title: The Farmers' Country Showdown
programme.desc: Rodney and Annabell’s Cumbrian farm has been in the family for 80 years, and since the beginning has always reared Ayrshire cattle. Meanwhile, Cheshire farmer Helen is getting her pedigree Red Poll cattle in top condition with welcome help from friend Thomas. She has set her sights on a champion win, but as both pairs are taking their own favourites into the show ring and will be in direct competition with one another, anything could happen.

Some friends find scampering squirrels, we see a flying one and a supersquirrel wearing a cape! The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way, and everyone has a boogie when Dee’s friend finally succeeds in saying today’s word.

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs

programme.title: Piggy Builders

programme.title: Twirlywoos

Then, back on the Big Red Boat, the Twirlywoos get a visit from the Robot, but there's a mishap and the Twirlywoos find themselves collecting all of his nuts, bolts and cogs!

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Justin and his friends go on a treasure hunt. Meanwhile, Mr Tumble has baked a cake for Aunt Polly’s birthday, but the cake ends up having an adventure all of its own!

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Tinky Winky puts Dipsy's hat in the bag - then Noo-noo hoovers them both up! The children in Tummy Tales pack a bag for an overnight stay with a relative, and the Teletubbies do a suitcase dance.

programme.title: The Baby Club
programme.desc: Giovanna and Baby Bear welcome babies Willow, Isobel, Lincoln, Ezra, Noah, Jason and their grown-ups to The Baby Club. Inside everyone’s bags in this episode are Building Blocks which are explored through discovery, play, song and story. Grown-ups at home are encouraged to take part by hiding safe, baby appropriate building blocks inside a fabric bag or pillowcase for them to reveal and explore with their baby! The fun rhyme ‘The grand old Duke of York’ features, as does a story involving Baby Bear. Plus, the Action Song gets everyone moving about, before some calm time with bubbles and the Goodbye Song.

programme.title: I Spy, You Spy
programme.desc: Elsee visits a market stall with her friend Annabelle to play a game of I-spy.

programme.title: What’s in Your Plant Pot?

programme.title: Let's Go for a Walk

programme.title: Kiri and Lou
programme.desc: Kiri has an imaginary party.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: A quick trip to the shops proves tricky for Dad, when Bingo and Bluey want to play a game of 'Kids'. Now Bluey is Mum, and Bingo is her baby. For Dad however, he is a very naughty boy.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: A big box is delivered to the Clubhouse, and the Squirrels are very excited. What could be inside? Oh! It is a huge box of bits and pieces. Duggee and the Squirrels are going to have to work very hard to put it all together. Time for a bit of teamwork.

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Henry plans a puppet show and with the help of little sister Sophie makes a whole host of puppets, including a dinosaur and a princess. But what will the audience think of the big performance? And will the princess escape from the dreaded dinosaur?

programme.desc: Children’s cookery series with Big Cook Jen and Little Cook Small. Jen starts a kitchen disco in the cafe while they bake cakes, but the radio runs out of batteries. Meanwhile, they cook a delicious robot fridge cake for Ruby Robot.

programme.title: The Summit
programme.desc: Thrilling reality series hosted by Ben Shephard. The 14 ordinary Brits who set off to climb one of New Zealand's highest peaks have now been reduced to 11 as brutal hikes and treacherous crossings prove too much for some - as the group grapple with who should leave the mountain at the first vote-off, Tyra, who is the slowest member of the group, hopes to convince the others that she should stay. The mental challenge of the journey is matched by the physical as the group set out once more but are confronted by a terrifying vertical cliff face which they must scale to get to the next base camp - pole fitness instructor Charlett and social media influencer Tara are pushed to their limits as they climb together hanging 1000 feet above the valley floor. The Mountain's Keeper, who is watching the group's every move, then forces their hand yet again with a difficult decision that has everyone feeling vulnerable.

programme.title: The Summit
programme.desc: Thrilling reality series hosted by Ben Shephard. The 14 ordinary Brits who set off to climb one of New Zealand's highest peaks have now been reduced to 11 as brutal hikes and treacherous crossings prove too much for some - as the group grapple with who should leave the mountain at the first vote-off, Tyra, who is the slowest member of the group, hopes to convince the others that she should stay. The mental challenge of the journey is matched by the physical as the group set out once more but are confronted by a terrifying vertical cliff face which they must scale to get to the next base camp - pole fitness instructor Charlett and social media influencer Tara are pushed to their limits as they climb together hanging 1000 feet above the valley floor. The Mountain's Keeper, who is watching the group's every move, then forces their hand yet again with a difficult decision that has everyone feeling vulnerable.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: Home improvement programme where contractor Brian McCourt and designer Sarah Keenleyside help to expand living spaces by tapping into people's backyards. Carly and Nate's social media star dog Dean the Basset Hound has a lot of four-legged friends and owners visiting that leave their home feeling cramped, so Brian and Sarah create a bar and lounge that provides space for pet and owner gatherings alike while also building a stylish outdoor entertainment area.

programme.title: Dress To Impress
programme.desc: Single shoppers Wolf, Em, and Michael are hoping to win the heart of teaching assistant Kieren - they'll be picking clothes based on his instructions, but will any of them hit the mark and impress him enough to win a date with a northern twist? Kieren will have no idea who is shopping for him and have to make his choice based entirely on the clothes that they choose for him!

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Salt Lake City
programme.desc: US reality series peeking inside the unconventional lives of six successful women living in or around Salt Lake City, Utah. The cast reunites to celebrate 100 episodes. Old tensions resurface and alliances are questioned as they revisit Bronwyn's controversy, Lisa and Whitney's rivalry, and the divisions that defined the season. Angie reveals evidence about the alleged leak.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Orange County
programme.desc: Reality show following the lavish lifestyles of five 'housewives' and their families. The ladies partake in several local activities in Amsterdam as Emily receives a distressing call from Shane, Heather finds comfort in visiting her parents' former home before spreading her father's ashes, and Gina struggles with a scandalous rumour that has been circulating and results in an explosive confrontation during their final dinner in the city.

programme.title: The Only Way is Essex
programme.desc: After it all kicked off at Courtney's birthday party, there is some unresolved tension in Essex - however, the news that Yaz was involved in a serious car crash has put things in perspective for the group. Even the usually fiery Chloe Brockett reaches out to Junaid, which leaves Ella worried that this might affect her new friendship group - meanwhile, it's all change for Saff. After recently turning 30, she decides that it's time to finally leave the family home and move into a place of her own - she enlists the help of her friends to declutter and realises that she is holding on to more than just material things, but how will her dad take the news of her moving out, and where will Saff move to? Diags is struggling to adjust to his life as manager at Plumb Point - luckily, Dan and Gatsby are on hand with support and suggest that he practices his interview and management skills. Will Diags show the boys that he is management material, or will he crack under the pressure?

programme.title: Dawson's Creek
programme.desc: US drama series charting the ups and downs of adolescence as experienced by a group of precocious teenagers. As a hurricane moves inland and threatens Capeside, the gang takes refuge at Mr and Mrs Leery's house - however, the weather outside gives way to storms of a different nature as Dawson criticises Jen about her promiscuous past and Mitch learns of his wife Gale's affair.

programme.title: Charmed
programme.desc: Classic US supernatural drama about three sisters who fight the forces of evil using their combined power of witchcraft known as the Power of Three. Prue dreams about a handsome admirer who turns out to be a Freddy Krueger-style killer able to enter his victims' minds and dispatch them in a variety of gruesome ways - not to be left out in the romance stakes, Phoebe and Piper then cast a spell to attract men... but it ends up too strong and lands them with more suitors than any girl could want.

programme.title: Deal or No Deal
programme.desc: Stephen Mulhern hosts as Alex M sits in the hot seat and opens the iconic red boxes - he may cash out with one of the Banker's tempting offers or stay strong for a shot at the 100,000-pound jackpot.

programme.title: Supermarket Sweep
programme.desc: Rylan Clark-Neal hosts the iconic game show as three pairs of shoppers go wild in the aisles and compete in the ultimate supermarket challenge to win a 3,000-pound prize - along with the classic Supermarket Sweep quizzes, trolley dashes and pastel jumpers, the revamped show features exciting new games, challenges and some famous faces.

programme.title: The Floor US
programme.desc: Rob Lowe hosts the American version of the game show. Only 16 players remain, and the stakes have never been higher as they battle for a spot in the finale.

programme.title: The Only Way is Essex
programme.desc: After having it out with Amber, Harry feels that Brockett's meddling has made a mountain out of a molehill when it comes to his and Amy's supposed griping, but will he call her out for running her mouth, or will Brockett bare her grievances first? Elsewhere, Brockett speculates that her freshly reconciled friendship with Saff will be at risk if Saff can't hold her tongue on the topic of Amber - will they be able to work through their issues when they meet up, or will we witness a classic TOWIE blow-up? Although Junaid and Brockett are happy that the beef is over between them, there's one person who's not - Ella. After finally feeling content in a friendship group, worries start to creep in that she might be left behind by her besties - will Junaid stay loyal to Ella, will Brockett break him away from his newly-formed friendships, and will Ella's emotions come to the surface?

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Salt Lake City
programme.desc: US reality series peeking inside the unconventional lives of six successful women living in or around Salt Lake City, Utah. The reunion continues with Mary sharing an emotional update about her son and how she feels about her church being in the spotlight. The women attempt to come to a resolution about what happened on the plane ride from Canouan. Heather draws a line in the sand with Meredith. Meredith provides some insight into the shocking root of her issues with Britani.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Orange County
programme.desc: Reality show following the lavish lifestyles of five 'housewives' and their families. The OC ladies come face-to-face for a dramatic 19th series reunion where Shannon confronts Tamra, Katie reflects on her early exit, Emily opens up on her son's diagnosis and Andy Cohen questions Tamra about her behaviour.

programme.title: The Floor US

programme.title: The 1% Club

This is the quiz that the whole family can play together - 100 contestants begin every show and try to make it to the end to answer a question that only one per cent of the country can get right and win up to 100,000 pounds.

programme.title: The Summit
programme.desc: Thrilling reality series hosted by Ben Shephard. The 14 ordinary Brits who set off to climb one of New Zealand's highest peaks have now been reduced to 11 as brutal hikes and treacherous crossings prove too much for some - as the group grapple with who should leave the mountain at the first vote-off, Tyra, who is the slowest member of the group, hopes to convince the others that she should stay.
